title: Approvals
description: GOTCHA has done the work. These are the decisions it can't take on its own.
unavailable: We couldn't read your approvals just now.

detail.lapsed: The deadline passed, so this can no longer be decided here. GOTCHA has handed the conversation to a person.
detail.outcomeUnknown: This was approved before GOTCHA recorded what happened next, so we can't tell you whether it ran. It can't be retried — re-running it could repeat something that already happened.

announce.approvedButFailed: Approved: {summary}. It did not run — you can try again.

error.stale: Someone else decided this, or its deadline passed. Reloading to show where it stands.
error.reason_required: Say why before rejecting — GOTCHA uses the reason to stop asking wrongly.

rest.lead: Nothing needs a decision from you.
rest.body: Everything that came up was inside the limits you set. GOTCHA handled it and kept going.

decided.heading: What you decided
decided.unavailable: We couldn't read your past decisions just now.
decided.lapsed: Deadline passed at {when} — handed to a person
decided.didNotRun: You approved this, but it didn't run. Open it to try again.
decided.outcomeUnknown: Approved before GOTCHA recorded what happened next, so we can't say whether it ran.
decided.incomplete: This shows your most recent decisions, not all of them — GOTCHA can only hand back the last hundred of each kind.

moment.factExecutionFailed: GOTCHA could not carry it out.
moment.factCustomerNotYet: The customer hasn't been told yet.
